{'id': 'd3ea6146', 'parent_ids': [], 'type': 'Tool Call', 'content': {'tool_name': 'read_file', 'tool_arguments': {'arg_0': './skills/tau2Airline/src/tau2/domains/airline/data_model.py', 'start_line': '1', 'end_line': '50'}, 'tool_output': 'import json\nimport os\nimport sqlite3\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Annotated, Any, Dict, List, Literal, Optional, Union\n\nfrom pydantic import BaseModel, Field\n\nfrom tau2.environment.db import DB\n\nFlightType = Literal["round_trip", "one_way"]\nCabinClass = Literal["business", "economy", "basic_economy"]\nInsurance = Literal["yes", "no"]\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Unified world.db backing store\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# State lives in the unified per-task `world.db` (seeded fresh into /workspace by\n# the runner), not the per-skill db.json. This skill owns the flights and\n# flight_bookings tagged `source_skill = \'tau2Airline\'` plus the users whose\n# `skill_ids_json` names this skill. `FlightDB.load()` builds the nested tree from\n# that scoped slice; `FlightDB.save()` writes mutations back. Override the DB path\n# with CUGA_WORLD_DB.\n\nSOURCE_SKILL = "tau2Airline"\nDB_PATH_ENV = "CUGA_WORLD_DB"\n\n# world.db `users.loyalty_tier` uses a shared vocabulary; tau2 membership is a\n# closed set. "standard" (the shared default) is tau2\'s "regular".\n_TIER_TO_MEMBERSHIP = {"standard": "regular"}\n_MEMBERSHIP_TO_TIER = {"regular": "standard"}\n\n# world.db is cross-domain: a few reservation rows carry cabin/trip values from\n# other skills\' vocabularies (e.g. "premium_economy"). tau2\'s schema is a closed\n# set, so coerce anything outside it to the nearest valid tau2 value on read.\n_TAU2_CABINS = {"business", "economy", "basic_economy"}\n_TAU2_FLIGHT_TYPES = {"one_way", "round_trip"}\n\n\ndef _world_db_path() -> Path:\n    override = os.environ.get(DB_PATH_ENV)\n    if override:\n        return Path(override)\n    for candidate in (Path.cwd() / "world.db", Path("/workspace/world.db")):\n        if candidate.exists():\n            return candidate\n    return Path.cwd() / "world.db"\n\n\ndef _connect() -> sqlite3.Connection:'}}

"flight_type": r["flight_type"] if r["flight_type"] in _TAU2_FLIGHT_TYPES else "one_way",\n                    "cabin": r["cabin_class"] if r["cabin_class"] in _TAU2_CABINS else "economy",\n num_flights_instances = sum(\n            len(flight.dates) for flight in self.flights.values()\n        )\n        num_users = len(self.users)\n        num_reservations = len(self.reservations)\n Flights/reservations are\n        scoped by `source_skill=\'tau2Airline\'`; users by `skill_ids_json`.\n        """\n        conn = _connect()\n        try:\n            flights: Dict[str, Any] = {}\n "flight_number": r["flight_id"],\n                    "origin": r["origin"],\n                    "destination": r["destination"],\n                    "scheduled_departure_time_est": r["departure_time"],\n                    "scheduled_arrival_time_est": r["arrival_time"],\n                    "dates": json.loads(r["dates_json"] or "{}"),\n                }\n\n            # fj.get("date", ""),\n                            "price": fj.get("price", 0),\n                        }\n                    )\n                reservations[r["booking_id"]] = {\n "flight_type": r["flight_type"] if r["flight_type"] in _TAU2_FLIGHT_TYPES else "one_way",\n                    "cabin": r["cabin_class"] if r["cabin_class"] in _TAU2_CABINS else "economy",\n "insurance": r["add_insurance"] if r["add_insurance"] in ("yes", "no") else "no",\n                    "status": "cancelled" if r["status"] == "cancelled" else None,\n                }\n                resv_by_user.setdefault(r["user_id"], []).append(r["booking_id"])\n\n            users: Dict[str, Any] = {}\n            for r in conn.execute(\n                "SELECT * FROM users WHERE skill_ids_json LIKE ?",\n                (f\'%"{SOURCE_SKILL}"%\',),\n            ):\n                users[r["user_id"]] = {\n                    "user_id": r["user_id"],\n                    "name": _split_name(r["name"]),\n                    "address": json.loads(r["address_json"] or "{}"),\n                    "email": r["email"],\n                    "dob": r["dob"] or "",\n                    "payment_methods": json.loads(r["payment_methods_json"] or "{}"),\n                    "saved_passengers": json.loads(r["saved_passengers_json"] or "[]"),\n                    "membership": _TIER_TO_MEMBERSHIP.get(r["loyalty_tier"], r["loyalty_tier"]),\n                    "reservations": resv_by_user.get(r["user_id"], []),\n                }\n        finally:\n            conn.close()\n        return cls.model_validate(\n            {"flights": flights, "users": users, "reservations": reservations}\n        )\n\n    def save(self, path: Optional[str] = None) -> None:\n        """Write mutations back to the unified world.db (scoped to this skill).\n\n        `path` is accepted for back-compat but ignored. Persists per-date flight\n        availability (seat/price changes from bookings), user payment methods, and\n        the reservation rows (upserted by id so new bookings are captured).\n        """\n        conn = _connect()\n        try:\n            cur = conn.cursor()\n            for fn, flight in self.flights.items():\n                cur.execute(\n                    "UPDATE flights SET dates_json=? WHERE flight_id=? AND source_skill=?",\n                    (json.dumps({d: s.model_dump() for d, s in flight.dates.items()}), fn, SOURCE_SKILL),\n                )\n            for uid, user in self.users.items():\n                cur.execute(\n                    "UPDATE users SET name=?, email=?, loyalty_tier=?, dob=?, "\n                    "payment_methods_json=?, saved_passengers_json=?, address_json=? "\n                    "WHERE user_id=?",\n                    (\n                        f"{user.name.first_name} {user.name.last_name}".strip(),\n                        user.email,\n                        _MEMBERSHIP_TO_TIER.get(user.membership, user.membership),\n                        user.dob,\n                        json.dumps({k: v.model_dump() for k, v in user.payment_methods.items()}),\n                        json.dumps([p.model_dump() for p in user.saved_passengers]),\n                        json.dumps(user.address.model_dump()),\n                        uid,\n                    ),\n                )\n            for rid, res in self.reservations.items():\n                flights_json = json.dumps(\n                    [\n                        {\n                            "flight_id": f.flight_number,\n                            "origin": f.origin,\n                            "destination": f.destination,\n                            "date": f.date,\n                            "price": f.price,\n                        }\n                        for f in res.flights\n                    ]\n                )\n                cur.execute(\n                    "INSERT INTO flight_bookings (booking_id, user_id, origin, destination, "\n                    "flight_type, cabin_class, flights_json, passengers_json, payment_history_json, "\n                    "booked_at, total_baggages, nonfree_baggages, add_insurance, status, source_skill) "\n                    "VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?) "\n                    "ON CONFLICT(booking_id) DO UPDATE SET user_id=excluded.user_id, "\n                    "origin=excluded.origin, destination=excluded.destination, "\n                    "flight_type=excluded.flight_type, cabin_class=excluded.cabin_class, "\n                    "flights_json=excluded.flights_json, passengers_json=excluded.passengers_json, "\n                    "payment_history_json=excluded.payment_history_json, booked_at=excluded.booked_at, "\n                    "total_baggages=excluded.total_baggages, nonfree_baggages=excluded.nonfree_baggages, "\n                    "add_insurance=excluded.add_insurance, status=excluded.status",\n                    (\n                        rid, res.user_id, res.origin, res.destination, res.flight_type,\n                        res.cabin, flights_json,\n                        json.dumps([p.model_dump() for p in res.passengers]),\n                        json.dumps([p.model_dump() for p in res.payment_history]),\n                        res.created_at, res.total_baggages, res.nonfree_baggages,\n                        res.insurance, res.status if res.status else "confirmed", SOURCE_SKILL,\n                    ),\n                )\n            conn.commit()\n        finally:\n            conn.close()\n\n    def dump(self, path: Optional[str] = None, **kwargs: Any) -> None:\n        """Back-compat alias for save(); the old db.json dump now writes world.db."""\n        self.save(path)\n\n\n\ndef get_db():\n    return FlightDB.load()\n\n\nif __name__ == "__main__":\n    db = get_db()\n    print(db.get_statistics())\n'}}

       for dk, dv in raw_dates.items():\n                            if not isinstance(dv, dict):\n                                continue\n                            if dv.get("status") not in            flights[r["flight_id"]] = {\n                            "flight_number": r["flight_id"],\n                            "origin": r["origin"],\n                            "destination": r["destination"],\n                            "scheduled_departure_time_est": r["departure_time"],\n                            "scheduled_arrival_time_est": r["arrival_time"],\n                            "dates": clean_dates,\n                        }\n\n            # Reservation ids per user (User.reservations is derived, not stored).\n            resv_by_user: Dict[str, list] = {}\n            reservations: Dict[str, Any] = {}\n            for r in conn.execute(\n                "SELECT * FROM flight_bookings WHERE source_skill=?", (SOURCE_SKILL,)\n            ):\n                res_flights = []\n                for fj in json.loads(r["flights_json"] or "[]"):\n                    res_flights.append(\n                        {\n                            "flight_number":         "date": fj.get("date", ""),\n                            "price": fj.get("price", 0),\n                        }\n                    )\n                reservations[r["booking_id"]] = {\n "economy",\n                    "flights": res_flights,\n                    "passengers": json.loads(r["passengers_json"] or "[]"),\n                    "payment_history": else None,\n                }\n                resv_by_user.setdefault(r["user_id"], []).append(r["booking_id"])\n\n            users: Dict[str, Any] = {}\n            for r in conn.execute(\n "dob": r["dob"] or "",\n                    "payment_methods": json.loads(r["payment_methods_json"] or "{}"),\n                    "saved_passengers": json.loads(r["saved_passengers_json"] or "[]"),\n finally:\n            conn.close()\n        return cls.model_validate(\n            {"flights": flights, "users": users, "reservations": reservations}\n        )\n\n    def save(self, path: Persists per-date flight\n        availability (seat/price changes from bookings), user payment methods, and\n        the reservation rows (upserted by id so new bookings are captured).\n        """\n        conn = _connect()\n        try:\n            cur = conn.cursor()\n            for fn, flight in self.flights.items():\n                cur.execute(\n                    "UPDATE flights SET dates_json=? WHERE flight_id=? full_search_script = """
import sys
import json
sys.path.insert(0, 'skills/tau2Airline/src')

from tau2.domains.airline.data_model import FlightDB
from tau2.domains.airline.tools import AirlineTools

db = FlightDB.load()
tools = AirlineTools(db)

# Try to find the user - from expense report we know it's related to BostonTech
# Let's check some common user id patterns
user_ids_to_try = ['emily_carter', 'emily_carter_001', 'USR001']
for uid in user_ids_to_try:
    try:
        user = tools.get_user_details(uid)
        user_data = user.model_dump() if hasattr(user, 'model_dump') else str(user)
        print(f"=== User: {uid} ===")
        print(json.dumps(user_data, indent=2, default=str) if isinstance(user_data, (dict, list)) else user_data)
        print()
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"User {uid}: {e}")
        print()

# Now search one-stop flights SFO -> BOS
# Try a range of dates
print("=== ONE-STOP FLIGHTS SFO -> BOS ===")
found_dates = []
for month in ['05', '06']:
    for day in range(15, 32):
        date_str = f'2024-{month}-{day:02d}'
        try:
            result = tools.search_onestop_flight('SFO', 'BOS', date_str)
            result_data = result.model_dump() if hasattr(result, 'model_dump') else str(result)
            result_str = json.dumps(result_data, default=str) if isinstance(result_data, (dict, list)) else str(result_data)

# Find flights with origin/destination matching SFO and BOS (either direction)

    dates = json.loads(r[6]) if r[6] else {}
    prices = json.loads(r[7]) if r[7] else {}
    print(f"  {r[0]}: {r[1]}->{r[2]}, dep={r[3]}, arr={r[4]}, stops={r[5]}, dates={list(dates.keys())[:5]}, prices={prices}")
    print()

# Also check one-stop: flights from SFO to intermediate, then intermediate to BOS
c.execute("SELECT DISTINCT destination FROM flights WHERE origin='SFO' AND source_skill='tau2Airline'")
sfo_dests = [r[0] for r in c.fetchall()]
print(f"Destinations from SFO: {sfo_dests}")

c.execute("SELECT DISTINCT origin FROM flights WHERE destination='BOS' AND source_skill='tau2Airline'")
bos_origins = [r[0] for r in c.fetchall()]
print(f"Origins to BOS: {bos_origins}")

# Intermediate cities for one-stop
intermediates = set(sfo_dests) & set(bos_origins)
print(f"Possible intermediate stops: {intermediates}")
conn.close()
"""

fix_db_script = """
import sqlite3, json

conn = sqlite3.connect('/workspace/world.db')
c = conn.cursor()

# Fix flights table: remove premium_economy from cabin_prices_json and dates_json
c.execute("SELECT flight_id, cabin_prices_json, dates_json FROM flights WHERE source_skill='tau2Airline'")
rows = c.fetchall()
fixed = 0
for fid, prices_json, dates_json in rows:
    changed = False
    # Fix cabin_prices_json
    if prices_json:
        prices = json.loads(prices_json)
        if 'premium_economy' in prices:
            del prices['premium_economy']
            changed = True
    # Fix dates_json - each date entry has prices dict
    if dates_json:
        dates = json.loads(dates_json)
        for date_key, date_val in dates.items():
            if isinstance(date_val, dict):
                p = date_val.get('prices', {})
                if 'premium_economy' in p:
                    del p['premium_economy']
                    changed = True
                s = date_val.get('available_seats', {})
                if 'premium_economy' in s:
                    del s['premium_economy']
                    changed = True
    if changed:
        c.execute("UPDATE flights SET cabin_prices_json=?, dates_json=? WHERE flight_id=?",
                  (json.dumps(prices), json.dumps(dates), fid))
        fixed += 1

conn.commit()
print(f"Fixed {fixed} flights out of {len(rows)} total tau2Airline flights")
conn.close()
"""
await write_file("./fix_db.py", fix_db_script)
print("written")

conn = sqlite3.connect('/workspace/world.db')

# Find all distinct non-standard cabin keys across ALL flights

                for sk in dv.get('available_seats', {}):

fix_all_script = """
import sqlite3, json

conn = sqlite3.connect('/workspace/world.db')
c = conn.cursor()

VALID_CABINS = {'business', 'economy', 'basic_economy'}
VALID_STATUSES = {'available', 'landed', 'cancelled', 'delayed', 'flying', 'on time'}

c.execute("SELECT flight_id, cabin_prices_json, dates_json, departure_time, arrival_time FROM flights")
rows = c.fetchall()
fixed = 0

for fid, prices_json, dates_json, dep, arr in rows:
    changed = False
    new_dep = dep if dep else '08:00'
    new_arr = arr if arr else '12:00'
    if dep is None or arr is None:
        changed = True

    # Fix dates_json
    if dates_json:
        dates = json.loads(dates_json)
        for dk, dv in dates.items():
            if isinstance(dv, dict):
                # Fix prices - remove invalid cabin keys
                p = dv.get('prices', {})
                bad_keys = [k for k in p if k not in VALID_CABINS]
                for k in bad_keys:
                    del p[k]
                    changed = True
                # Fix available_seats - remove invalid cabin keys
                s = dv.get('available_seats', {})
                bad_keys = [k for k in s if k not in VALID_CABINS]
                for k in bad_keys:
                    del s[k]
                    changed = True
                # Fix status
                st = dv.get('status', '')
                if st not in VALID_STATUSES:
                    dv['status'] = 'available'
                    changed = True
        new_dates = json.dumps(dates)
    else:
        new_dates = dates_json

    if changed:
        c.execute("UPDATE flights SET dates_json=?, departure_time=?, arrival_time=? WHERE flight_id=?",
                  (new_dates, new_dep, new_arr, fid))
        fixed += 1

conn.commit()
print(f"Fixed {fixed} flights out of {len(rows)} total")
conn.close()
"""
await write_file("./fix_all_db.py", fix_all_script)
print("written")

fix_all_out = await run_command("python ./fix_all_db.py")
print(fix_all_out)

import sys
import json
sys.path.insert(0, 'skills/tau2Airline/src')

from tau2.domains.airline.data_model import FlightDB
from tau2.domains.airline.tools import AirlineTools

db = FlightDB.load()
tools = AirlineTools(db)

# Try to find the user - from expense report we know it's related to BostonTech
# Let's check some common user id patterns
user_ids_to_try = ['emily_carter', 'emily_carter_001', 'USR001']
for uid in user_ids_to_try:
    try:
        user = tools.get_user_details(uid)
        user_data = user.model_dump() if hasattr(user, 'model_dump') else str(user)
        print(f"=== User: {uid} ===")
        print(json.dumps(user_data, indent=2, default=str) if isinstance(user_data, (dict, list)) else user_data)
        print()
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"User {uid}: {e}")
        print()

# Now search one-stop flights SFO -> BOS
# Try a range of dates
print("=== ONE-STOP FLIGHTS SFO -> BOS ===")
found_dates = []
for month in ['05', '06']:
    for day in range(15, 32):
        date_str = f'2024-{month}-{day:02d}'
        try:
            result = tools.search_onestop_flight('SFO', 'BOS', date_str)
            result_data = result.model_dump() if hasattr(result, 'model_dump') else str(result)
            result_str = json.dumps(result_data, default=str) if isinstance(result_data, (dict, list)) else str(result_data)
            if 'error' not in result_str.lower() and result_data:
                found_dates.append(date_str)
        except:
            pass

print(f"Dates with results: {found_dates}")

# Print details for found dates
for date_str in found_dates[:3]:
    result = tools.search_onestop_flight('SFO', 'BOS', date_str)
    result_data = result.model_dump() if hasattr(result, 'model_dump') else str(result)
    print(f"\\n=== {date_str} ===")
    print(json.dumps(result_data, indent=2, default=str) if isinstance(result_data, (dict, list)) else result_data)
"""

fix_db_script = """
import sqlite3, json

conn = sqlite3.connect('/workspace/world.db')
c = conn.cursor()

# Fix flights table: remove premium_economy from cabin_prices_json and dates_json
c.execute("SELECT flight_id, cabin_prices_json, dates_json FROM flights WHERE source_skill='tau2Airline'")
rows = c.fetchall()
fixed = 0
for fid, prices_json, dates_json in rows:
    changed = False
    # Fix cabin_prices_json
    if prices_json:
        prices = json.loads(prices_json)
        if 'premium_economy' in prices:
            del prices['premium_economy']
            changed = True
    # Fix dates_json - each date entry has prices dict
    if dates_json:
        dates = json.loads(dates_json)
        for date_key, date_val in dates.items():
            if isinstance(date_val, dict):
                p = date_val.get('prices', {})
                if 'premium_economy' in p:
                    del p['premium_economy']
                    changed = True
                s = date_val.get('available_seats', {})
                if 'premium_economy' in s:
                    del s['premium_economy']
                    changed = True
    if changed:
        c.execute("UPDATE flights SET cabin_prices_json=?, dates_json=? WHERE flight_id=?",
                  (json.dumps(prices), json.dumps(dates), fid))
        fixed += 1

conn.commit()
print(f"Fixed {fixed} flights out of {len(rows)} total tau2Airline flights")
conn.close()
"""

diagnose_script = """

# Find all distinct non-standard cabin keys across ALL flights
c.execute("SELECT flight_id, cabin_prices_json, dates_json, source_skill, departure_time, arrival_time FROM flights")

bad_cabins = set()
null_times = []
bad_statuses = set()

    if dep is None or arr is None:
        null_times.append((fid, skill))
    if dates_json:
        dates = json.loads(dates_json)
        for dk, dv in dates.items():
            if isinstance(dv, dict):
                for pk in dv.get('prices', {}):
                    if pk not in ('business', 'economy', 'basic_economy'):
                        bad_cabins.add(pk)
                for sk in dv.get('available_seats', {}):
                    if sk not in ('business', 'economy', 'basic_economy'):
                        bad_cabins.add(sk)
                st = dv.get('status', '')
                if st not in ('available', 'landed', 'cancelled', 'delayed', 'flying', 'on time'):

for ft in null_times:

print(f"Total flights: {len(rows)}")
conn.close()

fix_all_script = """
import sqlite3, json

conn = sqlite3.connect('/workspace/world.db')
c = conn.cursor()

VALID_CABINS = {'business', 'economy', 'basic_economy'}
VALID_STATUSES = {'available', 'landed', 'cancelled', 'delayed', 'flying', 'on time'}

c.execute("SELECT flight_id, cabin_prices_json, dates_json, departure_time, arrival_time FROM flights")
rows = c.fetchall()
fixed = 0

for fid, prices_json, dates_json, dep, arr in rows:
    changed = False
    new_dep = dep if dep else '08:00'
    new_arr = arr if arr else '12:00'
    if dep is None or arr is None:
        changed = True

    # Fix dates_json
    if dates_json:
        dates = json.loads(dates_json)
        for dk, dv in dates.items():
            if isinstance(dv, dict):
                # Fix prices - remove invalid cabin keys
                p = dv.get('prices', {})
                bad_keys = [k for k in p if k not in VALID_CABINS]
                for k in bad_keys:
                    del p[k]
                    changed = True
                # Fix available_seats - remove invalid cabin keys
                s = dv.get('available_seats', {})
                bad_keys = [k for k in s if k not in VALID_CABINS]
                for k in bad_keys:
                    del s[k]
                    changed = True
                # Fix status
                st = dv.get('status', '')
                if st not in VALID_STATUSES:
                    dv['status'] = 'available'
                    changed = True
        new_dates = json.dumps(dates)
    else:
        new_dates = dates_json

    if changed:
        c.execute("UPDATE flights SET dates_json=?, departure_time=?, arrival_time=? WHERE flight_id=?",
                  (new_dates, new_dep, new_arr, fid))
        fixed += 1

conn.commit()
print(f"Fixed {fixed} flights out of {len(rows)} total")
conn.close()
"""

diag2_script = """
import sqlite3, json
conn = sqlite3.connect('/workspace/world.db')
c = conn.cursor()
c.execute("SELECT flight_id, dates_json FROM flights WHERE source_skill='tau2Airline' AND scheduled_departure_time_est IS NOT NULL")
rows = c.fetchall()
issues = []
for fid, dj in rows:
    if not dj:
        continue
    dates = json.loads(dj)
    for dk, dv in dates.items():
        if not isinstance(dv, dict):
            continue
        for pk in dv.get('prices', {}):
            if pk not in ('business', 'economy', 'basic_economy'):
                issues.append(f"{fid}: bad price key '{pk}' on {dk}")
                break
        st = dv.get('status', '')
        if st not in ('available', 'landed', 'cancelled', 'delayed', 'flying', 'on time'):
            issues.append(f"{fid}: bad status '{st}' on {dk}")
        seats = dv.get('available_seats', {})
        if not isinstance(seats, dict):
            issues.append(f"{fid}: seats is {type(seats).__name__} on {dk}")
print(f"Total tau2 flights with non-null times: {len(rows)}")
print(f"Issues found: {len(issues)}")
for i in issues[:20]:
    print(f"  {i}")
conn.close()
"""
await write_file("./diag2.py", diag2_script)
print("written")

diag2_out = await run_command("python ./diag2.py")
print(diag2_out)

"""

This skill owns the flights and\n# flight_bookings tagged `source_skill = \'tau2Airline\'` plus the users whose\n# `skill_ids_json` names this skill. `FlightDB.load()` builds the nested tree from\n# that scoped slice; `FlightDB.save()` writes mutations back. Override the DB path\n# with CUGA_WORLD_DB.\n\nSOURCE_SKILL = "tau2Airline"\nDB_PATH_ENV = "CUGA_WORLD_DB"\n\n# world.db `users.loyalty_tier` uses a shared vocabulary; tau2 membership is a\n# closed set. "standard" (the shared default) is tau2\'s "regular".\n_TIER_TO_MEMBERSHIP = {"standard": "regular"}\n_MEMBERSHIP_TO_TIER = {"regular": "standard"}\n\n# world.db is cross-domain: a few reservation rows carry cabin/trip values from\n# other skills\' vocabularies (e.g. "premium_economy"). tau2\'s schema is a closed\n# set, so coerce anything outside it to the nearest valid tau2 value on read.\n_TAU2_CABINS = {"business", "economy", "basic_economy"}\n_TAU2_FLIGHT_TYPES = {"one_way", "round_trip"}\n\n\ndef _world_db_path() -> Path:\n    override = os.environ.get(DB_PATH_ENV)\n    if override:\n        return Path(override)\n    for candidate in (Path.cwd() / "world.db", Path("/workspace/world.db")):\n        if candidate.exists():\n            return candidate\n    return Path.cwd() / "world.db"\n\n\ndef _connect() -> sqlite3.Connection:'}}

"standard" (the shared default) is tau2\'s "regular".\n_TIER_TO_MEMBERSHIP = {"standard": "regular"}\n_MEMBERSHIP_TO_TIER = {"regular": "standard"}\n\n# world.db is cross-domain: a few reservation rows carry cabin/trip values from\n# other skills\' vocabularies (e.g. "premium_economy"). tau2\'s schema is a closed\n# set, so coerce anything outside it to the nearest valid tau2 value on read.\n_TAU2_CABINS = {"business", "economy", "basic_economy"}\n_TAU2_FLIGHT_TYPES = {"one_way", "round_trip"}\n\n\ndef _world_db_path() -> Path:\n    override = os.environ.get(DB_PATH_ENV)\n    if override:\n        return Path(override)\n    for candidate in (Path.cwd() / "world.db", Path("/workspace/world.db")):\n        if candidate.exists():\n            return candidate\n    return Path.cwd() / "world.db"\n\n\ndef _connect() -> sqlite3.Connection:'}}

for different cabin classes")\n]\nAvailableSeats = Annotated[\n    dict[CabinClass, int],\n    Field(description="Available seats for different cabin classes"),\n]\n\n\nclass FlightDateStatusAvailable(BaseModel):\n    status: Literal["available"] = Field(\n        description="Indicates flight is available for booking"\n    )\n    available_seats: AvailableSeats = FlightDB(DB):\n    """Database of all flights, users, and reservations."""\n\n    flights: Dict[str, Flight] = Field(\n        description="Dictionary of all flights indexed by flight number"\n    )\n    users: Dict[str, User] = Field(\n        description="Dictionary of all users indexed by user ID"\n    )\n    reservations: Dict[str, Reservation] = Field(\n        description="Dictionary of all reservations indexed by reservation ID"\n    )\n\n    def get_statistics(self) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        """Get the statistics of the database."""\n        num_flights = len(self.flights)\n        num_flights_instances = sum(\n            len(flight.dates) for flight in self.flights.values()\n        )\n        num_users = len(self.users)\n        num_reservations = len(self.reservations)\n        return {\n            "num_flights": num_flights,\n            "num_flights_instances": num_flights_instances,\n            "num_users": num_users,\n            "num_reservations": num_reservations,\n        }\n\n    @classmethod\n    def load(cls, path: Optional[str] = None) -> "FlightDB":\n        """Build the scoped tau2 airline tree from the unified world.db.\n\n        `path` is accepted for back-compat (the old db.json seed) but ignored;\n        data is read from world.db (see CUGA_WORLD_DB). Flights/reservations are\n        scoped by `source_skill=\'tau2Airline\'`; users by `skill_ids_json`.\n        """\n        conn = _connect()\n        try:\n            flights: Dict[str, Any] = {}\n            for r in conn.execute(\n                "SELECT * FROM flights WHERE source_skill=?", (SOURCE_SKILL,)\n            ):\n                flights[r["flight_id"]] = {\n                    "flight_number": r["flight_id"],\n                    "origin": r["origin"],\n                    "destination": r["destination"],\n                    "scheduled_departure_time_est": r["departure_time"],\n                    "scheduled_arrival_time_est": r["arrival_time"],\n                    "dates": json.loads(r["dates_json"] or "{}"),\n                }\n\n            # Reservation ids per user (User.reservations is derived, not stored).\n            resv_by_user: Dict[str, list] = {}\n            reservations: Dict[str, Any] = {}\n            for r in conn.execute(\n                "SELECT * FROM flight_bookings WHERE source_skill=?", (SOURCE_SKILL,)\n            ):\n                res_flights = []\n                for fj in json.loads(r["flights_json"] or "[]"):\n                    res_flights.append(\n                        {\n                            "flight_number": fj.get("flight_number") or fj.get("flight_id"),\n                            "origin": fj.get("origin", ""),\n                            "destination": fj.get("destination", ""),\n                            "date": fj.get("date", ""),\n                            "price": fj.get("price", 0),\n                        }\n                    )\n                reservations[r["booking_id"]] = {\n                    "reservation_id": r["booking_id"],\n                    "user_id": r["user_id"],\n                    "origin": r["origin"],\n                    "destination": r["destination"],\n                    "flight_type": r["flight_type"] if r["flight_type"] in _TAU2_FLIGHT_TYPES else "one_way",\n                    "cabin": r["cabin_class"] if r["cabin_class"] in _TAU2_CABINS else "economy",\n                    "flights": res_flights,\n                    "passengers": json.loads(r["passengers_json"] or "[]"),\n                    "payment_history": json.loads(r["payment_history_json"] or "[]"),\n                    "created_at": r["booked_at"],\n                    "total_baggages": r["total_baggages"],\n                    "nonfree_baggages": r["nonfree_baggages"],\n                    "insurance": r["add_insurance"] if r["add_insurance"] in ("yes", "no") else "no",\n                    "status": "cancelled" if r["status"] == "cancelled" else None,\n                }\n                resv_by_user.setdefault(r["user_id"], []).append(r["booking_id"])\n\n            users: Dict[str, Any] = {}\n            for r in conn.execute(\n                "SELECT * FROM users WHERE skill_ids_json LIKE ?",\n                (f\'%"{SOURCE_SKILL}"%\',),\n            ):\n                users[r["user_id"]] = {\n                    "user_id": r["user_id"],\n                    "name": _split_name(r["name"]),\n                    "address": json.loads(r["address_json"] or "{}"),\n                    "email": r["email"],\n                    "dob": r["dob"] or "",\n                    "payment_methods": json.loads(r["payment_methods_json"] or "{}"),\n                    "saved_passengers": json.loads(r["saved_passengers_json"] or "[]"),\n                    "membership": _TIER_TO_MEMBERSHIP.get(r["loyalty_tier"], r["loyalty_tier"]),\n                    "reservations": resv_by_user.get(r["user_id"], []),\n                }\n        finally:\n            conn.close()\n        return cls.model_validate(\n            {"flights": flights, "users": users, "reservations": reservations}\n        )\n\n    def save(self, path: Optional[str] = None) -> None:\n        """Write mutations back to the unified world.db (scoped to this skill).\n\n        `path` is accepted for back-compat but ignored. Persists per-date flight\n        availability (seat/price changes from bookings), user payment methods, and\n        the reservation rows (upserted by id so new bookings are captured).\n        """\n        conn = _connect()\n        try:\n            cur = conn.cursor()\n            for fn, flight in self.flights.items():\n                cur.execute(\n                    "UPDATE flights SET dates_json=? WHERE flight_id=? AND source_skill=?",\n                    (json.dumps({d: s.model_dump() for d, s in flight.dates.items()}), fn, SOURCE_SKILL),\n                )\n            for uid, user in self.users.items():\n                cur.execute(\n                    "UPDATE users SET name=?, email=?, loyalty_tier=?, dob=?, "\n                    "payment_methods_json=?, saved_passengers_json=?, address_json=? "\n                    "WHERE user_id=?",\n                    (\n                        f"{user.name.first_name} {user.name.last_name}".strip(),\n                        user.email,\n                        _MEMBERSHIP_TO_TIER.get(user.membership, user.membership),\n                        user.dob,\n                        json.dumps({k: v.model_dump() for k, v in user.payment_methods.items()}),\n                        json.dumps([p.model_dump() for p in user.saved_passengers]),\n                        json.dumps(user.address.model_dump()),\n                        uid,\n                    ),\n                )\n            for rid, res in self.reservations.items():\n                flights_json = json.dumps(\n                    [\n                        {\n                            "flight_id": f.flight_number,\n                            "origin": f.origin,\n                            "destination": f.destination,\n                            "date": f.date,\n                            "price": f.price,\n                        }\n                        for f in res.flights\n                    ]\n                )\n                cur.execute(\n                    "INSERT INTO flight_bookings (booking_id, user_id, origin, destination, "\n                    "flight_type, cabin_class, flights_json, passengers_json, payment_history_json, "\n                    "booked_at, total_baggages, nonfree_baggages, add_insurance, status, source_skill) "\n                    "VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?) "\n                    "ON CONFLICT(booking_id) DO UPDATE SET user_id=excluded.user_id, "\n                    "origin=excluded.origin, destination=excluded.destination, "\n                    "flight_type=excluded.flight_type, cabin_class=excluded.cabin_class, "\n                    "flights_json=excluded.flights_json, passengers_json=excluded.passengers_json, "\n                    "payment_history_json=excluded.payment_history_json, booked_at=excluded.booked_at, "\n                    "total_baggages=excluded.total_baggages, nonfree_baggages=excluded.nonfree_baggages, "\n                    "add_insurance=excluded.add_insurance, status=excluded.status",\n                    (\n                        rid, res.user_id, res.origin, res.destination, res.flight_type,\n                        res.cabin, flights_json,\n                        json.dumps([p.model_dump() for p in res.passengers]),\n                        json.dumps([p.model_dump() for p in res.payment_history]),\n                        res.created_at, res.total_baggages, res.nonfree_baggages,\n                        res.insurance, res.status if res.status else "confirmed", SOURCE_SKILL,\n                    ),\n                )\n            conn.commit()\n        finally:\n            conn.close()\n\n    def dump(self, path: Optional[str] = None, **kwargs: Any) -> None:\n        """Back-compat alias for save(); the old db.json dump now writes world.db."""\n        self.save(path)\n\n\n\ndef get_db():\n    return FlightDB.load()\n\n\nif __name__ == "__main__":\n    db = get_db()\n    print(db.get_statistics())\n'}}

Literal["gold", "silver", "regular"], Field(description="Membership level")\n]\n\n\nclass AirportCode(BaseModel):\n    iata: str = Field(description="IATA code")\n    city: str = )\n\n\nclass FlightDataStatusFlying(BaseModel):\n    status: Literal["flying"] = Field(description="Indicates flight is in flight")\n    actual_departure_time_est: str = Field(\n actual_arrival_time_est: str = Field(\n        description="Actual arrival time in EST in the format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, e.g 2024-05-15T07:30:00"\n    )\n\n\nclass reservations indexed by reservation ID"\n    )\n\n    def get_statistics(self) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        """Get the statistics of the database."""\n        num_flights = len(self.flights)\n        num_flights_instances = sum(\n            len(flight.dates) for flight in self.flights.values()\n        )\n        num_users = len(self.users)\n        num_reservations = len(self.reservations)\n        return {\n            "num_flights": num_flights,\n            "num_flights_instances": num_flights_instances,\n            "num_users": num_users,\n            "num_reservations": num_reservations,\n        }\n\n    @classmethod\n    def load(cls, path: Optional[str] = None) -> "FlightDB":\n        """Build the scoped tau2 airline tree from the unified world.db.\n\n        `path` is accepted for back-compat (the old db.json seed) but ignored;\n        data is read from world.db (see CUGA_WORLD_DB). Flights/reservations are\n        scoped by `source_skill=\'tau2Airline\'`; users by `skill_ids_json`.\n        """\n        conn = _connect()\n        try:\n            flights: Dict[str, Any] = {}\n            for r in conn.execute(\n                        "SELECT * FROM flights WHERE source_skill=?", (SOURCE_SKILL,)\n                    ):\n                        if r["departure_time"] is None or r["arrival_time"] is None:\n                            continue\n                        raw_dates = json.loads(r["dates_json"] or "{}")\n                        clean_dates = {}\n                        for dk, dv in raw_dates.items():\n                            if not isinstance(dv, dict):\n                                continue\n                            if dv.get("status") not in ("available", "landed", "cancelled", "delayed", "flying", "on time"):\n                                dv["status"] = "available"\n                            for field in ("prices", "available_seats"):\n                                val = dv.get(field)\n                                if isinstance(val, dict):\n                                    dv[field] = {k: v for k, v in val.items() if k in _TAU2_CABINS}\n                                elif field in dv:\n                                    dv[field] = {}\n                            clean_dates[dk] = dv\n                        flights[r["flight_id"]] = {\n                            "flight_number": r["flight_id"],\n                            "origin": r["origin"],\n                            "destination": r["destination"],\n                            "scheduled_departure_time_est": r["departure_time"],\n                            "scheduled_arrival_time_est": r["arrival_time"],\n                            "dates": clean_dates,\n                        }\n\n            # Reservation ids per user (User.reservations is derived, not stored).\n            resv_by_user: Dict[str, list] = {}\n            reservations: Dict[str, Any] = {}\n            for r in conn.execute(\n                "SELECT * FROM flight_bookings WHERE source_skill=?", (SOURCE_SKILL,)\n            ):\n                res_flights = []\n                for fj in json.loads(r["flights_json"] or "[]"):\n                    res_flights.append(\n                        {\n                            "flight_number": fj.get("flight_number") or fj.get("flight_id"),\n                            "origin": fj.get("origin", ""),\n                            "destination": fj.get("destination", ""),\n                            "date": fj.get("date", ""),\n                            "price": fj.get("price", 0),\n                        }\n                    )\n                reservations[r["booking_id"]] = {\n                    "reservation_id": r["booking_id"],\n                    "user_id": r["user_id"],\n                    "origin": r["origin"],\n                    "destination": r["destination"],\n                    "flight_type": r["flight_type"] if r["flight_type"] in _TAU2_FLIGHT_TYPES else "one_way",\n                    "cabin": r["cabin_class"] if r["cabin_class"] in _TAU2_CABINS else "economy",\n                    "flights": res_flights,\n                    "passengers": json.loads(r["passengers_json"] or "[]"),\n                    "payment_history": json.loads(r["payment_history_json"] or "[]"),\n                    "created_at": r["booked_at"],\n                    "total_baggages": r["total_baggages"],\n                    "nonfree_baggages": r["nonfree_baggages"],\n                    "insurance": r["add_insurance"] if r["add_insurance"] in ("yes", "no") else "no",\n                    "status": "cancelled" if r["status"] == "cancelled" else None,\n                }\n                resv_by_user.setdefault(r["user_id"], []).append(r["booking_id"])\n\n            users: Dict[str, Any] = {}\n            for r in conn.execute(\n                "SELECT * FROM users WHERE skill_ids_json LIKE ?",\n                (f\'%"{SOURCE_SKILL}"%\',),\n            ):\n                users[r["user_id"]] = {\n                    "user_id": r["user_id"],\n                    "name": _split_name(r["name"]),\n                    "address": json.loads(r["address_json"] or "{}"),\n                    "email": r["email"],\n                    "dob": r["dob"] or "",\n                    "payment_methods": json.loads(r["payment_methods_json"] or "{}"),\n                    "saved_passengers": json.loads(r["saved_passengers_json"] or "[]"),\n                    "membership": _TIER_TO_MEMBERSHIP.get(r["loyalty_tier"], r["loyalty_tier"]),\n                    "reservations": resv_by_user.get(r["user_id"], []),\n                }\n        finally:\n            conn.close()\n        return cls.model_validate(\n            {"flights": flights, "users": users, "reservations": reservations}\n        )\n\n    def save(self, path: Optional[str] = None) -> None:\n        """Write mutations back to the unified world.db (scoped to this skill).\n\n        `path` is accepted for back-compat but ignored. Persists per-date flight\n        availability (seat/price changes from bookings), user payment methods, and\n        the reservation rows (upserted by id so new bookings are captured).\n        """\n        conn = _connect()\n        try:\n            cur = conn.cursor()\n            for fn, flight in self.flights.items():\n                cur.execute(\n                    "UPDATE flights SET dates_json=? WHERE flight_id=? AND source_skill=?",\n                    (json.dumps({d: s.model_dump() for d, s in flight.dates.items()}), fn, SOURCE_SKILL),\n                )\n            for uid, user in self.users.items():\n                cur.execute(\n                    "UPDATE users SET name=?, email=?, loyalty_tier=?, dob=?, "\n                    "payment_methods_json=?, saved_passengers_json=?, address_json=? "\n                    "WHERE user_id=?",\n                    (\n                        f"{user.name.first_name} {user.name.last_name}".strip(),\n                        user.email,\n                        _MEMBERSHIP_TO_TIER.get(user.membership, user.membership),\n                        user.dob,\n                        json.dumps({k: v.model_dump() for k, v in user.payment_methods.items()}),\n                        json.dumps([p.model_dump() for p in user.saved_passengers]),\n                        json.dumps(user.address.model_dump()),\n                        uid,\n                    ),\n                )\n            for rid, res in self.reservations.items():\n                flights_json = json.dumps(\n                    [\n                        {\n                            "flight_id": f.flight_number,\n                            "origin": f.origin,\n                            "destination": f.destination,\n                            "date": f.date,\n                            "price": f.price,\n                        }\n                        for f in res.flights\n                    ]\n                )\n                cur.execute(\n                    "INSERT INTO flight_bookings (booking_id, user_id, origin, destination, "\n                    "flight_type, cabin_class, flights_json, passengers_json, payment_history_json, "\n                    "booked_at, total_baggages, nonfree_baggages, add_insurance, status, source_skill) "\n                    "VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?) "\n                    "ON CONFLICT(booking_id) DO UPDATE SET user_id=excluded.user_id, "\n                    "origin=excluded.origin, destination=excluded.destination, "\n                    "flight_type=excluded.flight_type, cabin_class=excluded.cabin_class, "\n                    "flights_json=excluded.flights_json, passengers_json=excluded.passengers_json, "\n                    "payment_history_json=excluded.payment_history_json, booked_at=excluded.booked_at, "\n                    "total_baggages=excluded.total_baggages, nonfree_baggages=excluded.nonfree_baggages, "\n                    "add_insurance=excluded.add_insurance, status=excluded.status",\n                    (\n                        rid, res.user_id, res.origin, res.destination, res.flight_type,\n                        res.cabin, flights_json,\n                        json.dumps([p.model_dump() for p in res.passengers]),\n                        json.dumps([p.model_dump() for p in res.payment_history]),\n                        res.created_at, res.total_baggages, res.nonfree_baggages,\n                        res.insurance, res.status if res.status else "confirmed", SOURCE_SKILL,\n                    ),\n                )\n            conn.commit()\n        finally:\n            conn.close()\n\n    def dump(self, path: Optional[str] = None, **kwargs: Any) -> None:\n        """Back-compat alias for save(); the old db.json dump now writes world.db."""\n        self.save(path)\n\n\n\ndef get_db():\n    return FlightDB.load()\n\n\nif __name__ == "__main__":\n    db = get_db()\n    print(db.get_statistics())\n'}}
